canonical_EDE_definition: Axion-like scalar field with early cosmological-constant behavior before critical epoch, fractional density f_EDE at a_c or z_c, and rapid dilution after becoming dynamical; acoustic effect is reduced sound horizon allowing higher CMB-inferred H0.
non_negotiable_steps: Track/report f_EDE and log10(a_c) (or z_c conversion) when discussing EDE.
Compare to ΛCDM baseline under same CMB+DESI summary.
Separate early-time EDE shifts from late-time w0wa shifts.
State that Gaussian posteriors are approximations from summary means/errors, not chain samples.
implemented_scope: Summary-level reproduction and diagnostic plots; no raw Planck/ACT/DESI likelihood fit.
deviations: No CLASS/MontePython MCMC because raw likelihoods and chains are absent.
Δχ² for target DESI DR2 combination not present in local data file; contextual Δχ² values extracted from related work are reported separately.
